  • Constructor Details

    • SimulationRepository

      public SimulationRepository()
      Default constructor for the SimulationRepository class. Initializes an empty list of Simulation objects to manage in this repository.

  • Method Details

    • add

      public Simulation add(Simulation simulation)
      Adds a simulation to the repository. If a simulation with the same map, scenario, and user already exists, updates the existing simulation's year and budget instead.
      Parameters:
      simulation - the simulation to be added or updated in the repository
      Returns:
      the existing simulation if updated, or the newly added simulation

    • copyFrom

      public void copyFrom(SimulationRepository other)
      Copies the simulations from another SimulationRepository into this repository. Clears all existing simulations in this repository before copying.
      Parameters:
      other - the SimulationRepository from which simulations will be copied

    • updateSimulation

      public void updateSimulation(Map map, Scenario scenario, User user, int newYear, Budget newBudget)
      Updates the simulation parameters in the repository that match the specified map, scenario, and user. Updates the simulation's year and budget if a match is found.
      Parameters:
      map - the map associated with the simulation to update
      scenario - the scenario associated with the simulation to update
      user - the user associated with the simulation to update
      newYear - the new current year to set for the simulation
      newBudget - the new budget to set for the simulation

    • getSimulations

      public List<Simulation> getSimulations()
      Retrieves an immutable copy of the list of simulations managed by this repository.
      Returns:
      a list containing all simulations in the repository, returned as an unmodifiable copy

    • findBy

      public Optional<Simulation> findBy(Map map, Scenario scenario, User user)
      Finds a simulation that matches the given map, scenario, and user. Searches through the repository's simulations to locate a simulation that has the specified map, scenario, and user attributes.
      Parameters:
      map - the map to search for in the simulation
      scenario - the scenario to search for in the simulation
      user - the user associated with the simulation to search for
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the simulation if found, or an empty Optional if no match is found
